subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw allow trusted HTTP callers to trigger the existing Gateway `update.run` self-update flow, and if so should that be done by expanding the opt-in admin HTTP RPC plugin rather than adding a new `/admin/update` endpoint?
rationale: This changes who can invoke host package-manager work and restart orchestration over HTTP; the code path is plausible, but automation should not choose that security/product boundary.

options.title: Expose through admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Approve a narrow `update.run` allowlist expansion in the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, with docs and security tests for trusted private ingress only.

options.title: Keep HTTP update blocked
options.body: Leave update execution on WebSocket/CLI surfaces only and keep admin HTTP RPC limited to `update.status` for observability.

options.title: Design a separate endpoint
options.body: Sponsor a new endpoint only if maintainers want a distinct request/response contract that differs materially from Gateway RPC.

recommendation.title: Expose through admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `update.run` allowlist expansion in the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, with docs and security tests for trusted private ingress only.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available owner because he authored the update restart flow and merged the admin HTTP RPC boundary.
